about: Thames Centre is a municipality in Middlesex County, Ontario, east of London, covering Dorchester, Thorndale, and surrounding farmland along the Thames River—not a single city. Villages, farms, and rural roads share the landscape between London and Ingersoll. About 14,000 people live in Thames Centre.
